% =============================================================================
% results_numbers.tex  single source of truth for the headline numbers.
% =============================================================================
%
% WHERE THE NUMBERS COME FROM
%   Every value below is transcribed from a committed CSV under
%   notebooks/outputs/ (14.07.2026, 10-drug re-run). The source file and, where
%   a value is an aggregate, the exact reduction are noted per block. This file
%   is maintained BY HAND: unlike the ToxFam manuscript (whose results_numbers
%   is auto-generated from a JSON manifest), this repo has no extraction script
%   yet, so when a notebook is re-run these macros must be updated here.
%
% HOW THEY ARE USED
%   main.tex does \input{results_numbers} in the preamble, which defines the
%   \newcommand macros below. The section files then cite a number as the macro,
%   e.g. "\rhoFullScgpt{}" or "$\rho=\ridgePca$", never as a literal digit. So a
%   number appears in exactly one place; editing it here updates every mention.
%   (The two results tables in 04_results carry the full per-cell values inline,
%   since a table is itself a single location; the macros cover the prose.)
%
% HOW TO UPDATE
%   1. Re-run the relevant notebook -> refreshed CSV in notebooks/outputs/.
%   2. Read the value from that CSV (means over per-drug / per-fold rows where
%      noted) and edit the matching macro below.
%   3. Recompile (pdflatex main.tex, twice). No section file needs touching.
% =============================================================================

% === dataset (docs/project_progress.md, notebooks/04) 
\newcommand{\NLines}{180}          % SCP542 x CTRPv2 lines with post-QC labels
\newcommand{\NDrugs}{545}          % CTRPv2 compounds in the overlap
\newcommand{\NCells}{53{,}513}     % single cells
\newcommand{\NGenes}{22{,}722}     % genes in the distributed SCP542 matrix
\newcommand{\NIndep}{150}          % ~independent examples after held-out splits
\newcommand{\NHvg}{5{,}000}        % highly variable genes (hvg5000 variant)
\newcommand{\NVocab}{4{,}576}      % of those, in scGPT's vocabulary
\newcommand{\NLearn}{10}           % learnable-drug subset size

% === gene-symbol defect (notebooks/outputs/embeddings/gene_symbol_rescue.csv, 05.08.2026)
% Genes discarded as out-of-vocabulary that are in fact IN scGPT's vocabulary under
% their current HGNC symbol; recovered via prev_symbol in reference/hgnc_complete_set.txt.
\newcommand{\NRescuedAll}{775}     % all_genes variant
\newcommand{\PctRescuedAll}{3.6}   % % of each cell's transcriptome they carry
\newcommand{\NRescuedHvg}{129}     % hvg5000 variant

% === out-of-fold Spearman on auc_z, mean over the 10 learnable drugs 
% source: target/target_comparison.csv (mean of the per-drug `spearman` rows,
%         filtered by score=auc_z, heads, rep)
\newcommand{\rhoTenPca}{0.360}     % heads=K=10,  X_pca
\newcommand{\rhoTenScgpt}{0.396}   % heads=K=10,  X_scGPT
\newcommand{\rhoFullPca}{0.316}    % heads=K=545, X_pca
\newcommand{\rhoFullScgpt}{0.328}  % heads=K=545, X_scGPT

% === baselines / capacity: ablations/ablation_capacity.csv (`spearman`) 
\newcommand{\ridgePca}{0.343}      % ridge (line-level), X_pca
\newcommand{\mlpPcaR}{0.356}       % MLP (128,64) current, X_pca
\newcommand{\mlpScgptR}{0.402}     % MLP (128,64) current, X_scGPT
\newcommand{\linScgptR}{0.292}     % linear head, X_scGPT
\newcommand{\ParamsHi}{74{,}954}   % params, MLP (128,64)
\newcommand{\ParamsLo}{5{,}130}    % params, linear head
% train-to-val MSE gap on auc_z, MLP (128,64): val_mse - train_mse
\newcommand{\gapScgpt}{0.098}      % 0.8267 - 0.7290 (X_scGPT)
\newcommand{\gapPca}{0.464}        % 0.9639 - 0.4995 (X_pca)

% === DrEval LCO, normalized, mean over folds 1-5 
% source: dreval/dreval_lco_results.csv (`Spearman: normalized`, `R^2: normalized`)
\newcommand{\drScgptSp}{0.357}     % OncoMLP (X_scGPT)
\newcommand{\drScgptRsq}{0.114}    % OncoMLP (X_scGPT)
\newcommand{\drPcaSp}{0.340}       % OncoMLP (X_pca)
\newcommand{\drPcaRsq}{0.086}      % OncoMLP (X_pca)
\newcommand{\drRfSp}{0.339}        % SingleDrugRF (scgpt)
